questions.stem: Which of the following represents an even number algebraically?
questions.explanation: $2n$ represents an even number for any integer $n$, because even numbers are always multiples of $2$. $2n + 1$ represents an odd number.

questions.stem: Two consecutive integers can be written as $n$ and $n + 1$. Their sum is:
questions.explanation: $n + (n + 1) = 2n + 1$. This is always odd, which proves that the sum of two consecutive integers is always odd.
